text:
Type: grey velvet grommet curtains, pair
Use: dimming light, framing windows, adding privacy; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: contemporary, glam, classic
Materials: heavy velvet with a soft sheen, metal grommets along the top
Colors: dark slate grey, silver grommets
Shape: two long straight panels hanging in deep even folds from grommets on a rod, floor length, heavy and rich drape
Feel: luxurious, cozy, calm, enveloping
Goes with: grey or white walls, brass or chrome accents, dark wood; contemporary, glam or classic rooms

product.name: SANELA
product.description: The thick curtains darken the room and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing into the room.
